items: What is the longest surah of the Quran?
Al-Baqarah has 286 verses and is the longest surah.
How many surahs does the Quran have in total?
The Mushaf has 114 surahs, from Al-Fatihah to An-Nas.
Which surah does not begin with the Basmalah?
At-Tawbah is the only surah that does not start with the Basmalah.
From which surah were the first verses revealed to the Prophet?
The first five verses of Al-'Alaq begin with 'Read'.
Which surah has a name meaning 'the spider'?
Verse 41 compares those who take protectors besides God to a spider's house.
Which surah has a name meaning 'the ant'?
In verse 18 an ant warns its colony about Sulayman's army.
Which bird brought Prophet Sulayman news of the Queen of Sheba?
The hoopoe reported its discovery of the land of Sheba to Sulayman.
How does Surah Al-Muzzammil say the Quran should be recited?
The Quran says to recite it with measured recitation.
What is the complete recitation of the Quran from beginning to end called?
Completing a reading of the whole Quran is called a khatm.
What is a person who has memorised the entire Quran called?
One who has memorised the whole Quran is a hafiz.
What science teaches the correct pronunciation rules for reciting the Quran?
Tajwid teaches the rules of correct and beautiful recitation.
What is the science of explaining the meaning of the Quran's verses called?
Tafsir is the explanation of the meanings and rulings of the Quran.
Over roughly how many years was the Quran revealed?
The revelation lasted about 23 years, from the start of the mission until the Prophet's passing.
In which surah does Isa (Jesus) give the glad tidings of a messenger named 'Ahmad' who would come after him?
In verse 6 Isa says he brings glad tidings of a messenger whose name is Ahmad.
Which surah begins by swearing by the fig and the olive?
Surah At-Tin begins 'By the fig and the olive'.
Which surah begins by swearing by the sun and its brightness?
Surah Ash-Shams begins with an oath by the sun and its morning brightness.
Which surah begins by swearing by the morning brightness?
Ad-Duha begins with an oath by the forenoon.
Which surah begins 'Nun. By the pen and what they write'?
Al-Qalam begins with an oath by the pen and what is written with it.
In which surah is the verse 'You have your religion and I have mine' found?
The last verse of Al-Kafirun sets out freedom of belief and separation from idolatry.
In which surah is the verse 'He neither begot nor was begotten' found?
Verse 3 of Al-Ikhlas denies that God has a child or a parent.
Which surah begins 'When the help of God and victory come'?
An-Nasr announces God's help and victory, understood as the conquest of Mecca.
Which prophet's name appears most often in the Quran?
Count of prophets' names in the Quran
Musa and his story are mentioned more than any other prophet.
Which is the only month named in the Quran?
Ramadan is the only month mentioned by name, as the month in which the Quran was revealed.
In which surah is fasting prescribed for the believers?
Verse 183 says that fasting was prescribed for the believers as for those before them.
In which surah are believers told to hold firmly to the rope of God together?
Verse 103 of Al Imran calls Muslims to hold fast together to God's rope.
What are Surah Al-Falaq and Surah An-Nas called together?
They are called the two surahs of seeking refuge.
What are Surah Al-Baqarah and Surah Al Imran called together?
They are known together as 'the two radiant ones'.
According to the preferred view, which was the first surah revealed in Medina after the Hijrah?
Books on the Quranic sciences list Al-Baqarah as the first Medinan surah.
Which of the following surahs is Madani?
An-Nisa was revealed in Medina; the other three are Makki.
Which of the following surahs is Makki?
Al-Kahf was revealed in Mecca; the other three are Madani.
In which surah is the verse 'God is the Light of the heavens and the earth' found?
Verse 35 of An-Nur is known as the Verse of Light.
What is the number of Surah Al-Mulk in the Mushaf?
Al-Mulk is the 67th surah and has 30 verses.
In which surah is the verse 'The believers are but brothers' found?
Verse 10 of Al-Hujurat states that believers are brothers and calls for reconciliation.
How many verses does Surah Ya-Sin have?
Which surah is the second longest in the Quran by number of verses?
After Al-Baqarah comes Ash-Shu'ara with 227 verses; Al Imran has 200.
In which surah are believers told to leave trade and hurry to remember God when called to prayer?
Verse 9 of Al-Jumu'ah tells believers to leave business and go to the remembrance of God.
In which surah is 'This day I have perfected your religion for you' found?
Verse 3 of Al-Ma'idah announces the perfection of the religion and the completion of God's favour.
Which surah begins with the Night Journey from the Sacred Mosque to the Farthest Mosque?
Al-Isra begins with 'Glory to Him who took His servant by night'.
In which surah is the Lote Tree of the Furthest Boundary (Sidrat al-Muntaha) mentioned?
Verse 14 of An-Najm mentions Sidrat al-Muntaha.
How many verses does Surah Al-Qadr have?
Surah Al-Qadr consists of five verses.
In which surah is the prayer 'My Lord, increase me in knowledge' found?
Verse 114 of Ta-Ha teaches the prayer 'My Lord, increase me in knowledge'.
In which surah is 'You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help' found?
Verse 5 of Al-Fatihah declares that worship and help are for God alone.
Which is the first surah after Al-Fatihah to begin with the disjointed letters Alif-Lam-Mim?
Which name of the Quran means 'the criterion that separates truth from falsehood'?
Al-Furqan is one of the Quran's names and also the title of a surah.
In which surah is the instruction to call to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good counsel found?
Verse 125 of An-Nahl sets out the method of inviting with wisdom and good counsel.
In which surah is the Prophet described as being of 'a great moral character'?
Al-Qalam 4: 'And indeed, you are of a great moral character.'
In which surah is the Messenger of God called 'an excellent example'?
Al-Ahzab 21 describes the Messenger of God as an excellent model.
In which surah is the Prophet described as sent only as a mercy to the worlds?
Al-Anbiya 107 says the Prophet was sent as a mercy to all the worlds.
In which surah was Ibrahim told to proclaim the Hajj to the people?
Al-Hajj 27 commands Ibrahim to announce the pilgrimage to people.
In which surah does it say the first house established for mankind is the one at Bakkah (Mecca)?
Al Imran 96 says the first house of worship set up for people is the blessed Kaaba.
